{{Quote|Too bad I have to kill such a good pilot.|The mercenary leader, to Rhys Dallows during their final meeting|<ref name="SW:SF" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''mercenary''' leader was [[Mercenary/Legends|employed]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. He flew a [[Unidentified mercenary craft|specialized craft]] and [[Attempted kidnapping of Queen Amidala|fought]] [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] when the Trade Federation attempted to kidnap the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Essara Till/Legends|Essara Till]]. The mercenary leader also disabled [[Rhys Dallows]]' [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]]. Dallows was later rescued, and met the mercenary leader again during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|final battle of the invasion]]. Dallows pursued the mercenary inside the Trade Federation's [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] and dueled him to the point of the mercenary's [[Death/Legends|death]].

==History==
{{Quote|Let me put a stop to your futile efforts!|The mercenary leader, before killing Essara Till|<ref name="SW:SF" />}}
[[File:BattleOfNaboo-SWJB.png|thumb|left|250px|The mercenary's final battle]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] leader [[Pilot/Legends|was hired]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]<ref name="SW:SF" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> He first took part in the events of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] when the Trade Federation [[Attempted kidnapping of Queen Amidala|lured]] the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] into an ambush. A squadron of mercenary craft [[Starfighter combat/Legends|engaged]] portions of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] as the Queen was escorted by [[Essara Till/Legends|Essara Till]] and [[Rhys Dallows]]. While piloting [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]], the two Naboo pilots, destroyed all the attackers. After the Queen had escaped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the mercenary leader shot down Till's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] with his [[Unidentified mercenary craft|craft's]] [[Missile/Legends|missiles]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] her. He then turned his weapons onto Dallows, disabling his starfighter. Dallows was later rescued by the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] junker, [[Reti]], and the two eventually joined the [[Naboo Resistance]].<ref name="SW:SF" />

Dallows and the mercenary leader met again during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|final battle of the Naboo conflict]] when the Naboo pilots of Bravo Flight were assaulting the Trade Federation's [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] to disable the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. After the N-1 starfighters destroyed the first wave of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] and the Control Ship's Receiver Stations, the mercenary leader joined the battle and shot down one of the Naboo pilots. Dallows pursued the mercenary and successfully damaged his ship, but not before the mercenary was able to launch missiles in return. Dallows survived their explosions, but while the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay shields were down when the Control Ship launched a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]], the mercenary ducked into the right-hand hangar. He was pursued inside by Dallows and they dueled inside the hangar. After their duel, the mercenary was forced to fall back deeper inside the Control Ship. Dallows continued his pursuit, and the mercenary flew through the power grid and into the innermost hangar. There, Dallows confronted him again. As they dueled, the mercenary complimented Dallows' skill, expressing regret about killing the talented Naboo pilot. Ultimately, Dallows proved to be the superior pilot, and the mercenary died when his craft exploded.<ref name="SW:SF" />

==Behind the scenes==
This individual, identified as Mercenary Leader by the targeting computer, appears in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]. It's possible this character is voiced by [[Tom Kane]].

The ship model of the mercenary leader bears the logo of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], a pirate organization that also makes its first appearance within ''Star Wars: Starfighter''. However, no other connections are established between the organization and the mercenary leader.
